name: Meraki
description: Meraki is a completed apartment development in Yadavagiri. Nine 3 BHK homes are laid out for generous shared space and daylight, with premium fittings throughout.

items: RCC framed structure
6" thick AAC eco-friendly blocks for walls
Gypsum plaster to internal ceilings and walls
Waterproof cement plaster to external surfaces
800 × 800 mm premium floor tiles to living areas
300 × 300 mm anti-skid ceramic tiles to wet areas
300 × 450 mm glazed tiles to bathroom walls, up to false-ceiling height
300 × 450 mm glazed tiles to the kitchen panel, two feet high
False ceiling in toilets
Teak wood frame with veneer-finish shutters to the main door
Natural wood veneer finish to internal doors
WPC shutters to toilets and utility areas
Premium stainless steel door hardware
2 and 3 track UPVC windows with MS grills
FRLS copper cables
Modular switches, Anchor Roma or equivalent
Generator backup to lift, common utilities and common-area lighting
1 kW backup to each apartment
CPVC pipes for water supply, PVC for drainage
Chrome-finish sanitary fittings to toilet and kitchen, Jaquar or equivalent
White sanitary fixtures, Hindware or equivalent
Stainless steel sink with drain board on a granite top
Sink and washing-machine provision in the utility
Acrylic emulsion paint to walls and ceilings
Enamel paint to doors and grills
Natural polish to the main door
